mod.help: Settings for the Rise Archer mod.

damage.title: Damage
damage.help: How hard bows, crossbows and ballistae hit.

upkeep.title: Weight & Value
upkeep.help: How heavy each weapon is and what it sells for.

ammo.title: Ammo & Shots
ammo.help: How much ammo you carry and how arrows and bolts fly.

bow_damage.label: Bow Damage
bow_damage.help: Damage multiplier for bows and greatbows. 1x = vanilla.

bow_scaling.label: Bow Scaling
bow_scaling.help: Stat scaling multiplier for bows and greatbows. 1x = vanilla.

bow_aow.label: Bow Ash of War
bow_aow.help: Lets every bow take an Ash of War.

bow_weight.label: Bow Weight
bow_weight.help: Weight multiplier for bows and greatbows.

bow_sell.label: Bow Sell Value
bow_sell.help: Sell price multiplier for bows and greatbows.

arrow_limit.label: Arrow Limit
arrow_limit.help: How many arrows you can carry. Vanilla is lower.

bolt_limit.label: Bolt Limit
bolt_limit.help: How many bolts you can carry. Vanilla is lower.

bullet_speed.label: Projectile Speed
bullet_speed.help: How fast arrows and bolts fly. 1x = vanilla.

rain_range.label: Rain Range
rain_range.help: How far Rain of Arrows reaches. 1x = vanilla.

rain_spread.label: Rain Spread
rain_spread.help: How wide Rain of Arrows spreads. 1x = vanilla.

rain_count.label: Rain Arrows
rain_count.help: How many arrows Rain of Arrows fires.

log.label: Log file
log.help: Write a log file next to the DLL, for troubleshooting.
